response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.zoneregistry, s.entrystat, m.facetfaces FROM sites AS s JOIN scanmesh AS m ON m.zoneref = s.zoneregistry), site_averages AS (SELECT zoneregistry, entrystat, AVG(facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM matched GROUP BY zoneregistry, entrystat), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(facetfaces) AS avg_faces FROM matched), status_averages AS (SELECT entrystat, AVG(avg_faces) AS avg_faces FROM site_averages WHERE entrystat IS NOT NULL GROUP BY entrystat) SELECT AVG(sa.avg_faces) AS avg_kept_faces, AVG(sa.avg_faces - b.avg_faces) AS avg_above_baseline, AVG(sa.avg_faces - sta.avg_faces) AS avg_above_status FROM site_averages AS sa JOIN status_averages AS sta ON sta.entrystat = sa.entrystat CROSS JOIN baseline AS b WHERE b.avg_faces IS NOT NULL AND sa.avg_faces > sta.avg_faces;
